notes: v2.143 (2026-11-28, morning run): 142nd tower 'Boots' (a rain boot — red pull-handle tab over a cuff and a yellow shaft on a green foot and a blue sole — a boot silhouette to demolish, 32 blocks, 4 clusters sizes 12/7/7/6, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) completing the pair with the existing Boots co-play prompt (pull your rain boots on by their handles saying 'pull… pull!', stomp in a puddle together saying 'stomp, stomp, splash!', then take them off and line them up by the door; boots go on second when dressing — coat, then boots, then hat, then mittens — and a grown-up checks the fit, with puddle play in shallow water with a grown-up nearby). Boots research: at 2, stomping in a puddle is a live cause-and-effect experiment (step in, splash happens) that practices balance on uneven, slippery surfaces on the way to the ~30-month two-feet-jump milestone; pulling boots on by their handles is the independence piece (light, flexible boots with pull handles are the ones a 2-year-old can get on alone); and the splash is multi-sensory input (cold, resistance, sound, spray) in one small act.
